source_verification: Every package file matched the authenticated git archive of this commit before capture.
capture_command: In a clean checkout of the source_commit, copy the revised tests/test_release_arrays.py into tests, then run python -B tests/test_release_arrays.py --capture-portable.
configuration: portable_config() in tests/test_release_arrays.py, using HDF5, 3/2/2 windows, 19 channels and 32 samples.
tolerance: Integer and label arrays compare exactly. Floating arrays use rtol=1e-10 and absolute tolerance 1e-12 times the reference array maximum magnitude.
